Name: Sailor Scarecrows (Configurable 1.6 Update)
Author: e8y
Description:
A fully configurable version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/386]old Sailor Scarecrows mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/30908805]keodau27[/url]. Each replacement is individually able to be enable or disabled, so if you want to mix and match with other replacement mods, that should now be easily achievable!

Now with configurable Rarecrow #9 (the strong one) in case you didn't like the evil queen as that replacement. (Remember that you must reload a cell to see the change.)

If you have any questions or requests for this mod, please let me know in the comments!

Additionally, thanks to CherrySymphony, there's now an AT version and a new sprite!

[b][u]Installation[/u][/b]

Either plop the unzipped contents in your Content/Mods folder, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url], the only mod organizer I recommend to be used with Stardew. It is [i]excellent [/i]and will save you time and hassle.

[u][b]Incompatibilities

[/b][/u]Should be compatible with all modern mods, except SOME of those that change the same assets. If those assets are not configurable, they likely won't work. For example, geenaxion's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23110]Ghibli Scarecrow for 1.6[/url]﻿ is fully configurable. Despite changing many of the same assets as this mod, you can simply turn off which ones you don't want and use both!

However, if a mod brute forces their changes by replacing the entire craftables file, it will be down to load order if this mod shows up or not.

As well, XNB mods that change craftables are not supported by me.

[b][u]Thanks

[/u][/b]keodau27 for the original mod!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/169820068]geenaxion[/url] for an easy to follow template using their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23110]Ghibli Scarecrow for 1.6[/url]﻿
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CherrySymphony]CherrySymphony[/url]for the Alternative Textures conversion and a sprite for the missing True Perfection Statue!

[b][u]Fun Facts
[/u][/b]
I had to make the new Rarecrow #9 option on my own!

Contrary to what I thought (despite my partner and I using the mod since its release) keodau27 did not simply rip the sprites, but remade them! They're considerably smaller than their source! Great work on their part!

Downloads.Description: Use this if you want to use Alternative Textures instead. With thanks to CherrySymphony!
Needs Content Patcher. Configurable using Generic Mod Config Menu (reccomended) or by using the json files.
